阳光透过百叶窗的缝隙，在床单上切出一道道金色的窄条。

林川是被一阵痒意弄醒的。

低头一看，沈蔓的脸埋在他的颈窝里，长发散开来，发尾扫在他的锁骨上。呼吸均匀，还在睡。

一条白皙的手臂横搭在他的胸口，五根手指微微蜷曲，像是在梦里也要确认他还在身边。

昨晚折腾了大半夜，这女人现在睡得像只小猫。

林川没动，就这么躺着，右手随意地搭在她光裸的肩膀上。指尖无意识地在她肩头画圈。

十分钟后，沈蔓动了。

她迷迷糊糊地蹭了蹭他的脖子，像是在找一个更舒服的角度。蹭了两下，忽然身体一僵——清醒了。

“几点了……”声音沙得不成样子。

“十点半。”

“啊？”沈蔓猛地抬头，一头乱发糊了半张脸。

林川伸手把她额前的碎发拨开，看着她惺忪的睡眼和微微红肿的嘴唇，嘴角勾了一下。

“好看。”

沈蔓瞪了他一眼，把脸重新埋回去。

“好看个鬼，妆都花了。”

她的声音闷闷的，透过胸腔传过来带着震动。但搂着他的手臂不仅没松，反而收得更紧了。

“起来吧，饿不饿？”林川拍了拍她的背。

“不起。”

“不起就不起。”林川也没强迫，另一只手摸到床头柜上的烟盒，单手抽出一根叼在嘴里。

刚要点火，一只手伸过来，把烟从他嘴里抽走了。

沈蔓撑起半个身子，眯着眼看他。被子滑落到腰际，露出一大片白腻的肌肤。

“大早上抽什么烟。”

她把烟扔到床头柜上，顺手把打火机也挪远了。然后又倒回他怀里，找了个更舒服的姿势窝好。

“再躺十分钟。”

林川看着她，没说话，只是笑了一声。

跟昨晚那个红着眼眶问他“以后会不会只有我一个”的女人判若两人。经过昨晚的摊牌，她反而安定了下来。不再患得患失地试探，取而代之的是一种认定之后的踏实。

最终还是林川先起的床。他走到厨房倒了杯温水端回来，沈蔓才不情不愿地坐起身，披着他的衬衫，光着两条长腿晃到洗手间。

等她洗漱出来，林川已经叫好了外卖。

艇仔粥、肠粉、虾饺，摆了半张餐桌。

沈蔓坐在餐桌对面吃粥，勺子搅了半天，忽然抬头。

“昨晚……谢谢你跟我们一起吃饭。”

“谢什么，答应你的事。”

沈蔓低下头，嘴角弯了弯。“天爱今早给我发消息，一连串感叹号，说做梦都没想到能上游艇。”

她顿了一下，声音压低了一点：“璐璐也说……说你不像一般人。”

林川夹了个虾饺放进她碗里。

“吃饭。”

沈蔓看着碗里多出来的虾饺，忽然笑了。不是那种矜持的微笑，是真的、发自心底的、眼睛弯成月牙的笑。

下午两点。

林川开车带沈蔓去了华强北附近一条不太起眼的商业街。没去大商场，找了家风格简约的女装买手店。

这种店没有铺天盖地的LOGO，但面料、剪裁、版型一看就不是地摊货。价格不便宜，一件真丝衬衫小两千，但也不夸张。

沈蔓挑衣服的时候，林川就坐在休息区翻杂志。

偶尔抬头看一眼试衣间的方向，她每出来一次，他就看两秒，然后说“这件行”或者“换一件”。

沈蔓试到第四套的时候，忍不住笑着骂他：“你比我们组长还挑。”

“组长又不花钱。”

最后拎了四个袋子出来。衣服、鞋、两套护肤品，加起来不到两万。

上车之后，林川发动引擎，单手打方向盘往外倒车。

“把卡号发我。”

沈蔓愣了一下：“什么？”

The sun shines through the gaps in the blinds, cutting narrow golden strips on the sheets.

Lin Chuan was woken up by a burst of itching.

Looking down, Shen Man's face was buried in the crook of his neck, her long hair spread out, and the ends of her hair brushed against his collarbone.Breathing evenly, still sleeping.

A white arm was placed across his chest, with five fingers slightly curled, as if to confirm that he was still around in a dream.

After struggling most of the night last night, this woman now sleeps like a kitten.

Lin Chuan didn't move, just lying there, his right hand casually resting on her bare shoulder.His fingertips unconsciously drew circles on her shoulders.

Ten minutes later, Shen Man moved.

She nuzzled his neck in a daze, as if looking for a more comfortable angle.After rubbing it twice, my body suddenly stiffened - I woke up.

"What time is it..." The voice was hoarse.

"Ten thirty."

"Ah?" Shen Man raised his head suddenly, half of his face obscured by his messy hair.

Lin Chuan stretched out his hand to push away the broken hair from her forehead, looked at her sleepy eyes and slightly red and swollen lips, and raised the corners of her mouth.

"Good looking."

Shen Man glared at him and buried his face again.

"You look so good, all your makeup is gone."

Her voice was muffled, vibrating through her chest.But instead of loosening the arms around him, they tightened even more.

"Get up, are you hungry?" Lin Chuan patted her back.

"I can't afford it."

"If you can't afford it, you can't afford it." Lin Chuan didn't force him. He reached for the cigarette case on the bedside table with his other hand, took one out and held it in his mouth.

Just as he was about to light the fire, a hand reached out and took the cigarette away from his mouth.

Shen Man propped up half of his body and looked at him with squinted eyes.The quilt slid down to her waist, revealing a large area of ​​white and greasy skin.

"What are you smoking so early in the morning?"

She threw the cigarette on the bedside table and moved the lighter away.Then she fell back into his arms and found a more comfortable position.

"Lie down for another ten minutes."

Lin Chuan looked at her, said nothing, and just laughed.

She is completely different from the woman who asked him with red eyes last night, "Will I be the only one in the future?"After last night's showdown, she settled down instead.There is no longer a temptation to worry about gains and losses, but instead there is a sense of steadiness after recognition.

In the end, Lin Chuan got up first.He walked to the kitchen and poured a glass of warm water and brought it back. Shen Man reluctantly sat up, put on his shirt, and swung to the bathroom with her long legs bare.

By the time she came out of the shower, Lin Chuan had already ordered takeout.

Tingzi porridge, rice rolls and shrimp dumplings were served on half a dining table.

Shen Man was sitting across the dining table eating porridge. He stirred the porridge for a long time and suddenly looked up.

"Last night...thank you for dining with us."

"Thank you for what I promised you."

Shen Man lowered his head and curved the corners of his mouth."Tianai sent me a message this morning, a series of exclamation points, saying that I never dreamed that I would be able to board a yacht."

She paused and lowered her voice a little: "Lulu also said... that you are not like ordinary people."

Lin Chuan put a shrimp dumpling into her bowl.

"Eat."

Shen Man looked at the extra shrimp dumplings in the bowl and suddenly smiled.Not that kind of reserved smile, but a real smile that comes from the bottom of my heart, with eyes that are shaped like crescent moons.

2 p.m.

Lin Chuan drove Shen Man to an inconspicuous commercial street near Huaqiang North.Instead of going to a big mall, I found a simple women's clothing store.

This kind of store does not have an overwhelming LOGO, but the fabrics, tailoring, and styles make it clear that they are not local products.The price is not cheap, a silk shirt costs less than two thousand, but it is not exaggerated.

While Shen Man was picking out clothes, Lin Chuan was sitting in the rest area reading magazines.

Occasionally he would look up in the direction of the fitting room. Every time she came out, he would look at her for two seconds and then say "This one will work" or "Change another one".

When Shen Man tried the fourth set, she couldn't help laughing and scolding him: "You are more picky than our team leader."

"The team leader doesn't spend money."

Finally, I came out with four bags.Clothes, shoes, and two sets of skin care products total less than 20,000 yuan.

After getting in the car, Lin Chuan started the engine, turned the steering wheel with one hand and reversed the car.

"Send me your card number."

Shen Man was stunned for a moment: "What?"
